tabs.description:
The tabs, in order: "emoji" | "symbols" | "nerd" (Nerd Fonts icons; without it their list is never fetched).

Takes a list of words ("emoji", "symbols" or "nerd"). Default: ["emoji","symbols","nerd"].

openTab.description:
The tab it opens on: one of them, or "last".

Takes "emoji", "symbols", "nerd" or "last". Default: "emoji".

nerdPick.description:
What Enter takes of a Nerd Fonts icon: "glyph" | "name". The other is Ctrl+Enter.

Takes "glyph" or "name". Default: "glyph".

recents.description:
A row of what you picked lately stands above the list.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

pick.description:
A pick is "paste" (pasted into the window the picker was opened over, and copied) | "copy" (copied only).

Takes "paste" or "copy". Default: "paste".
